texts.mood.minor_cups_03.family: You may feel a quiet joy around the people closest to you. A small moment together, a meal or a call, can mean more than usual today.
texts.influence.major_03_empress.upright.famil: Venus brings warmth to your family life. Your care is felt, even when no one says it. This is a good day to be gentle with yourself as well.
texts.advice.major_07_chariot.family: If something at home needs a decision, move forward calmly. You don't need to control everything, only to choose your direction.
texts.closing.major_07_chariot.family: Call or visit someone in your family today, just to listen.
